theorem.K500_composition: To certify leakage <=mu, require the derived word lower L_n to satisfy ||(1-P_n)W_n v_n||<=mu L_n uniformly in n.
theorem.criterion: If C_n>=epsilon_n I and ||x_(n,p)||^2>=s_(n,p), then ||v_n||^2>=epsilon_n sum_p |c_(n,p)|^2 s_(n,p).
theorem.finite_prefix_boundary: Checking this criterion for finitely many n does not establish the required uniform all-level statement.
